description_expanded: Overview5.0(15 reviews)Gulf Views - Private Pool - Private Beach- Golf Cart Option - 1 Minute Walk - 5 bikes - `Seas the Day`The SpaceYour Seagrove Beach Escape Awaits!QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Steps to the Beach – Just a short, scenic stroll to the sugar-white sands! Private Pool (Heat Optional) – Relax & unwind in your own tropical oasis! Spacious Living Area – Perfect for gathering with family & friends. 5 FREE Bikes – Cruise 30A in style! Great Location – Nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Wi-Fi – Stay connected & stream your favorites. Driveway Parking for 4 Cars – Plenty of space for your group. Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Stress-free vacation planning! GOLF CART option - 6 Seater golf cart available to rent at discounted costWelcome to Seas The DayThe minute you pull in the driveway, you will be pleased you chose this home for your 30A vacation. Seas the Day is a 5 bedroom, 5.5 bath home with a private pool, steps to the Seagrove beach and enough room to sleep 14 in beds. Distinctive styling and spectacular outdoor living spaces set this beautiful home apart.The shiplap walls welcome you as you open the front door with an open and airy feel. You can see through the front door out into the pool area, breathtaking. The great room that hosts the living, dining, and kitchen areas are a perfect gathering spot. You will struggle with going to the beach or watching your favorite college team on the 55” Smart TV. Lounging on the extra comfy sofas will make the decision that much harder. The pool area is spacious, inviting and serene. Equipped with seating and lounging areas, flanked by palm trees.The first floor boasts 2 bedrooms, each with their own en suite bath. One of the two king masters is down stairs and the en suite bath has a stand-up shower with a double vanity. A cozy king bedroom features an en suite bathroom with a tub/shower combo. In the hall right before the great room is the powder room.As you walk up the stairs to the second floor, you are greeted with multiple bedrooms and a second gathering spot. The bunk room has a queen over queen bunk with a shared bathroom for the gathering room and guest bedroom, double vanity and shower/tub combo. The guest bedroom has a king bed. In the gathering room, you have a TV and balcony with a swing bed.The main master is on this level with a king bed, shared balcony with the gathering room and a very large, spacious en suite master bathroom.The third and final stop is the tower room. Ascend the spiral stairs and enter the best view in the house! This spot has a mini kitchen, bistro table with bar stools, and a futon. When you open the door to see the Gulf you will wish you had stocked the mini kitchen!Let’s talk about the walk to the beach. You will feel like you are walking through an enchanting forest and then BAM! You are greeted with the sugary white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf. Yes, we will be available for you to book your return trip.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**Pool Heat* Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st* Pool Heat fee $50 per day and required for length of stay* Pool heat is not guaranteedSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (13):Master: King sized bed, private bathMaster: King sized bed, private bathGuest: King sized bed, shared bathBunk Room: Queen over queen bunks, shared bathMaster: King sized bed, en suite bathCrows Nest - FutonAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
